content.title: Miley Cyrus Is Engaged! See Rare Photos of the Grammy-Winning Singer with Her Fiancé Maxx Morando
content.text: The newly-engaged couple is surprisingly low-key, only stepping out together a handful of times in their four years together Updated on December 2, 2025 06:00PM EST Maxx Morando and Miley Cyrus. Credit : Francis Specker/CBS via Getty Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando are engaged! The "Flowers" singer and her drummer beau were first linked back in 2021, before they unofficially officially confirmed their relationship when they were spotted kissing while out in West Hollywood in April 2022. In the three years since, the pair have attended several red carpet events together, including the December 1 premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash at which Cyrus showed up wearing a diamond ring on her left-hand ring finger, sparking engagement rumors. On December 2, a source confirmed to PEOPLE that the lovebirds are engaged. Francesca Consulting, a rep for jewelry designer Jacquie Aiche, confirmed to PEOPLE that Aiche made the "bespoke" ring, which features a cushion-cut stone set on a thick, 14-karat yellow gold band. "She is very happy with him," an insider told PEOPLE back in 2024. “Miley has changed a lot in the past couple of years. She seems more calm and harmonious. Everyone loves Maxx. He’s a great guy. He’s private and doesn’t like being in the press. It’s been good for her." Below, see the rare photos of Miley Cyrus and her fiancé. She Said, 'Yes!' Maxx Morando and Miley Cyrus. Kevin Winter/WireImage Cyrus wasn't shy about showing off her rock at the premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash. Musical People Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando. Lester Cohen/Getty Earlier this year, the couple looked rock n' roll chic as they attended the Grammys in coordinating black and white ensembles. Hand-in-Hand Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando. ASPN / BACKGRID On June 6, they were spotted holding hands while exiting a private event in New York City. Under the Limelight Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando. XNY/Star Max/GC Images The same night, the lovebirds gave full glamour for their night out in the city. Red Carpet Pros Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando. TheStewartofNY/WireImage The couple looked super cool at SNL50: The Anniversary Special in February. Kisses For You Maxx Morando and Miley Cyrus. Francis Specker/CBS via Getty Miley and her beau were snapped sharing a kiss at the 2024 Grammy Awards at which she walked away with two trophies. Fashion Forward Maxx Morando and Miley Cyrus. Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock In 2023, the pair put their most fashionable feet forward and showed up to the Versace fashion show looking like they just stepped straight out of a music video. A Night with Oscar Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando. Michael Buckner/Penske Media via Getty Speaking to Harper's Bazaar about their six-year age difference, Miley told the publication it works out just fine because they "just don’t take life too seriously," though she noted that Morando "looks at life really differently than I do." "He grew up with a laptop. I had a desktop computer that I shared with my brothers and sisters," she explained. "Honestly, he’s raised our dog off Reddit. I'm like, 'Are you sure we’re supposed to be doing this?' And he’s like, 'On Reddit it says blah, blah, blah.'" Family Matters Maxx Morando, Miley Cyrus, and Brandi Cyrus. Francis Specker/CBS Things have been serious between the two for a while – he sat with her family (including sister Brandi) at the Grammys in 2024. Fun with Fashion Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando.
